visual_language.creative_thesis: Operational clarity as an editorial artifact: decisive type, quiet surfaces, and evidence that earns the accent.
visual_language.color_behavior: Ink, paper, and one signal accent reserved for verified evidence and focus.
visual_language.typography: Large compressed-feeling display hierarchy paired with a measured, highly readable body rhythm.

shared_visual_systems.card_treatment: Avoid repeated floating cards; use ruled evidence panels and full-bleed typographic intervals.
shared_visual_systems.spacing: Alternate dense evidence clusters with generous reading pauses.
shared_visual_systems.shape: Fine rules, square corners, and a single offset evidence tab.

navigation_direction.form: anchor navigation that behaves as a quiet index

motion_system.global_character: one restrained line-draw or opacity reveal; static state retains all meaning

interaction_system.hover: focus-visible evidence underline and a nonessential accent shift

accessibility_and_performance.reduced_motion: Use static evidence tabs and no entry animation

scenes.layout_intent: Asymmetric text-led hero with an offset evidence index.
A ruled editorial sequence that lets the verified statement interrupt the principles.
A compressed method ledger that opens into a deliberately quiet closing.

acceptance_criteria: Make the reading sequence distinct without fabricated imagery.
Keep all interaction meaning available with reduced motion.

direction.responsive_summary: On small screens, preserve sequence and evidence priority; stack the offset tab below its claim.
